text:
maria: Heads-up — recording didn't start for the intro, stream console shows 'no encoder'. Can someone check the capture rig? I'm going to postpone opening remarks by ~5-10min.
streaming-bot: Recording job failed to start: RTMP handshake error. (automated)
sam: I'll jump on the room A laptop. @devon can you switch the backup AV laptop to HDMI2?
devon: On it. grabbing the HDMI cable now.
jamie: Leadership Q&A — can we move the first poll and roadmap bit to after we confirm recording? Need to give Lars extra time while we fix.
kai: Captioner is still offline. @ops can you ping Skyline caption service? we might need manual captions.
ops: Skyline incident acknowledged, ticket INC-7832. ETA ~8m. Also spinning up an RTMP -> YouTube fallback just in case.
sam: Quick fallback command if needed (using OBS CLI):
```
obs-cli start-stream --profile "AllHands-Fallback" --rtmp "rtmp://youtube/live/xxx"
```
maria: Thanks. If recording can't be confirmed in 10m we'll move to Q&A-only and record the deck later. Is that ok? :thinking_face:
devon: HDMI switch done. Starting local OBS capture now. I see audio levels, mic 1 is hot though, pulling it down. :thumbsup:
streaming-bot: Recording started on obs-node-3. Archive will be available in ~10m.
jamie: Great — updating the agenda in the doc and telling Lars to prep a shorter intro. @maria can you confirm whether we still want the roadmap demo?
maria: Let's keep the roadmap but shorten the demo to 7m and skip deep-dive. Move the poll to the end. Everyone OK with that?
kai: OK from captions side; manual captioner will join in 2m and re-sync when Skyline returns.
ops: Confirmed: Skyline service returning, captions should re-sync in ~3m. Deploying temporary retention toggle so the backup archive is safe.
maria: Awesome — thanks everyone. I'll post a 2-min heads up before we start live Q&A. Action item: check OBS auto-start and encoder health for next all-hands (adding to runbook).
thread_text_snippet: Heads-up — recording didn't start for the intro...
